route_prior_method: Beta(1,1) smoothed grounded-success rate among policy-eligible development_tune answers; R3 has no eligible answers and retains the neutral prior.
eligibility_rule: answerable status AND valid response contract AND citations within supplied context AND at least one citation
notes: All inputs are available at inference time. Benchmark answers, gold pages, answerability labels, and correctness labels are not score inputs. Numeric answer thresholds remain reserved for development_calibration.
